top_story.headline: Quiet day: no new ethics or disclosure filings found, and two sources were unavailable
top_story.dek: The lobbying and foreign-agent feeds could not be read today.
paragraphs: The Office of Government Ethics pass found nothing significant, and every House and Senate financial disclosure in the lookback window had already been reported in earlier editions.
The Senate lobbying disclosure site (lda.gov) was returning errors, and the foreign-agent registration pages from the U.S. Department of Justice returned no readable rows, so neither was verified.

sections.headline: No significant ethics filings reported this period
paragraphs: The Office of Government Ethics' public database shows 34 filings submitted during the period of October 7–11, 2026, with no divestitures, ethics agreement amendments, or other filings flagged for reporting.

footer.coverage_window: Oct. 9, 2026 00:00 Pacific through early Oct. 10, 2026 (financial disclosures: filed Oct. 7 onward, deduplicated against prior editions)
footer.sources: OGE's ethics-filing search endpoint; DOJ FARA e-file system; Senate Office of Public Records LDA API; Clerk of the House financial disclosures; Senate eFD.
footer.known_gaps: lda.gov returned HTTP 503 / timed out on repeated attempts, so LDA registrations and activity were not checked today. The FARA new/terminated registrant pages returned HTML with no row data in the initial response (the report table appears to load client-side), so FARA registrants could not be verified today. All House (11) and Senate (3) disclosure filings in the lookback window were already reported in earlier editions.
